purpose: Teach: むら/しづ/やめよ/資料館/遅かっ/カモ/ゴロ/栓

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、私のメイク、色むら、ひどいかな、今日?
lines.en: Riku, is my makeup looking really uneven today?
lines.style: Quick, self-conscious ask. Eyes half-searching his face for reassurance. Vulnerable but trying to sound casual. Slight uptick at the end like she's bracing for honest feedback.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。しづちゃん先輩、引退、寂しいよな、部活。
lines.en: Yeah. Having Shizu-chan senpai retire from the club… it's weird, you know?
lines.style: Softer turn mid-thought. Quiet realization emerging. Gentle, genuinely reflective — not performing sadness but noticing it. Slight pause before speaking, like he's been thinking about this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夜遅くまで、漫画読むの、もうやめようと思ってるの。
lines.en: I've been thinking I should stop reading manga so late at night.
lines.style: Firmer than before. Sincere self-awareness. Not seeking agreement — stating a decision she's been turning over. Direct, almost to herself, but speaking it aloud to make it real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 土曜、町の歴史資料館、課題で行かないとな。
lines.en: Saturday I have to go to the town history museum for an assignment.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery with a wry edge underneath. Slightly resigned but not complainy — just acknowledging an obligation. Dry humor in the flatness of it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん。電車、遅かったね、今朝も。
lines.en: Yeah. The train was late again this morning too.
lines.style: Simple agreement, almost commiserating. Tired nod in the voice. Shared recognition of an annoying pattern. Low energy, matching his.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 池のカモ、いっぱいいるな、今日。
lines.en: There were so many ducks at the pond today.
lines.style: Sudden brightness — genuine observation breaking through the heavier talk. Light, present moment. A small smile in the voice like he's actually noticing something that caught his eye.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、家でゴロ寝ばかり、しちゃダメだよね。
lines.en: I can't just laze around at home before the test, right?
lines.style: Self-questioning but resolute underneath. Seeking acknowledgment but more speaking her own resolve aloud. Slight tension — knowing what she should do and steeling herself to do it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 運動会の打ち上げ、ジュースの栓、皆で抜いたな。
lines.en: We all popped open those juice bottles together after the sports day celebration.
lines.style: Warm memory surfacing. Brightness and ease. Genuine fondness in the phrasing — he's recalling a moment where everyone was together and happy. Light, almost nostalgic in a present way.
